text: The 'Segal types' in Simplicial TT are types satisfying the Segal condition. An equivalent formulation is:
choices: The type is a Kan complex
Composition of morphisms is uniquely defined (the composition space is contractible)
explanation: Segal: for any f:hom(a,b) and g:hom(b,c), the space of composites is contractible (unique composition).
